description:
Interact with Gemini Veo video-generation via a mini command-line encoded in the `text` field.

Supported commands:
  create --prompt "text" [--image path] [--aspect-ratio 16:9] [--duration 6] [--person-generation dont_allow] [--output video.mp4] [--wait]
  status <operation-id>
  get <operation-id> --output video.mp4
  list [--status active|completed|failed]

Prompting hints (summarised from Veo documentation):
• Include the following elements when possible →  Subject  |  Context  |  Action  |  Style  |  Camera motion  |  Composition  |  Ambiance.
• Be descriptive and clear; use rich adjectives and adverbs.
• Provide relevant background/context so the model understands the scene.
• Reference specific artistic or cinematic styles ("film-noir", "3D cartoon", etc.).
• Use video terminology such as "dolly shot", "tracking shot", "extreme close-up".
• Negative prompts: list elements you want to discourage the model from generating (no instructive language).
• Aspect-ratio choices: 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (portrait).
• Duration must be 5–8 seconds; request 1 or 2 videos.
• Tips: utilise prompt-engineering tools, mention facial details explicitly for portraits, keep language concise but vivid.

Return value is either an operation-id, JSON status, or a confirmation string when a file is saved.
